user.title: Add a Harman EasyTouch stove
user.description: Pick the power sensor (watts) for this stove. It is only used to build the 20 second moving average. Choose an existing profile, or choose "Import / design a new profile" to continue to the profile editor.

import_profile.title: Import / design a profile
import_profile.description: Paste profile JSON, or edit the example below. The profile is saved under its "name" and used for this stove. Built-in profile names cannot be overwritten.

error.reserved_name: That name belongs to a built-in profile. Use a different "name".

abort.already_configured: A stove with this name already exists.

import_profile.title: Import / design a profile
import_profile.description: Paste profile JSON, or edit the current profile shown below. It is saved under its "name" and applied to this stove, so change the "name" to keep the original as well. Built-in profile names cannot be overwritten.

error.reserved_name: That name belongs to a built-in profile. Use a different "name".
